transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
My work physical is what got me here. The doctor said my weight was too low, but honestly, I just feel lighter on my feet for basketball and less weighed down at the garage.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yeah, I guess I am. If the scale goes up even a pound, or my jeans start feeling tighter, I think I’m getting soft. I don’t want to feel slower at work or on the court.
Do you feel like you’re overweight?
I don’t know if I’d say overweight, but if the scale goes up or my jeans get tighter, I feel like I’m getting soft. Like I’ll be slower moving around cars at work or on the court.
Do you feel fat even when other people say you’re too thin?
I mean, when the number goes up even a little or my jeans feel tighter, I start thinking I’m getting soft. Then I worry I won’t move as well around cars or up and down the court.
Have you been purposely eating less to keep your weight down?

Yeah. Most days it’s just coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich or half of whatever’s around later. With the shop running late and things busy at home, I feel better keeping to those simple rules.
Have you lost a lot of weight from what you used to weigh?
I guess so—the work physical is what brought this up. The doctor said my weight was too low, but I just feel lighter on my feet playing basketball and less weighed down at the garage.
Are you trying to keep your weight as low as it is?
Yeah, I guess I am. If the scale goes up even a pound, or my jeans start feeling tighter, I worry I’m getting soft and won’t be as quick moving around cars or up and down the court.
Do you ever have episodes where you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short time and feel unable to stop?
No, I don’t think so. I don’t really have times where I eat a huge amount or feel like I can’t stop.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating to keep from gaining weight?
No, I haven’t done that.
Do you exercise extra to keep from gaining weight?
I’m not sure what you mean by extra. I stay active with work and moving around, but I haven’t really thought of it as exercising to make up for eating.
Have your periods stopped?
Um, I’m male, so I don’t have periods.
Do you ever skip meals on purpose to avoid gaining weight?

Yeah, most days I do. I’ll just have coffee in the morning, then maybe a small sandwich or half of something later. With the shop running late and things busy at home, I feel better keeping to those simple rules.
What is your current height and weight?
I don’t know the exact numbers offhand. At my work physical, the doctor said my weight was too low. I just feel lighter on my feet for basketball and not so weighed down at the garage.
Do you know your current weight?
I don’t know the number, no. The work doctor just said it was too low. I feel okay, though—lighter for basketball and less weighed down at the garage.
Do you think your current low weight is a serious health problem?

I know people are worried, but I think they’re making more of it than it is. I’m still going to work, handling things at home, and playing basketball on weekends, so I don’t see it as a serious problem.
